scripts.dev:full: npm run build && concurrently -k "vite --host 0.0.0.0" "wrangler pages dev dist --port 8788 --ai AI"
scripts.build: tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p functions/tsconfig.json && vite build
scripts.pages:dev: npm run build && wrangler pages dev dist --ai AI
scripts.deploy: npm run build && wrangler pages deploy dist
